- Continuous completion of left wraps to down in same scan. Single-cycle completion returns idle.
- At start of new automatic sequence (action 1, not every individual single step), UpLimitSwitch and LeftLimitSwitch both TRUE.

    currentMode := 1;

    currentMode := 2;
ELSIF SingleCycleMode THEN
